title: Blind fix
description: Output of blind-fix: whether the claimed defect holds, and if so exact search-and-replace edits that fix it. The fixer never sees the reproduction test. Strict, so Codex --output-schema accepts it.

edits.description: Applied in order. Empty when not feasible.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root.

old.description: Exact text to replace, copied from the file, including indentation. It must occur exactly once in the file at that point in the sequence. Empty string means create a new file.

new.description: Replacement text (the whole content for a new file).
